title: Everyday Phrases — Souvenir Shopping
scene_zh: 買紀念品 · 情境對話
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】🎁 實用買紀念品必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A1 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — Souvenir Shopping
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用買紀念品情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），從逛紀念品店問東西的意義、挑明信片冰箱貼鑰匙圈送人、砍價湊優惠包裝禮物寫卡片，到結帳退稅、寄禮盒回家與道別，400句一次聽好。不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical Souvenir Shopping phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue), covering the whole trip to the gift shop: browsing local crafts and asking what they mean, picking postcards, magnets and keychains for friends, bargaining, gift wrapping and writing cards, then paying, claiming tax refund, shipping a box home and saying goodbye. No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 這裡好多色彩繽紛的東西！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The shelves are full of local crafts.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ʃɛlvz ɑr fʊl ʌv ˈloʊkəl kræfts/
dialogue.zh: 架子上擺滿了當地的手工藝品。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is this small wooden box?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It holds tea from the hills.
dialogue.zh: 它裝的是山上產的茶葉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 上面畫的是老城區的傳說故事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 都是藝術家手繪上去的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 所以拿來送人特別有心意。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 這些帽子有什麼講究嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This blue one fits me well!
dialogue.zh: 這頂藍色的戴上剛剛好！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, pure silk from the region.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 這是我們賣得最好的一款。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Those bells are made of brass.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this a good luck charm?
dialogue.zh: 這是招好運的護身符嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why is this doll in costume?
dialogue.zh: 這個娃娃為什麼穿著傳統服裝？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It wears a village wedding dress.
dialogue.zh: 它穿的是村莊裡的婚禮嫁衣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The little face is so cute!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 我家孩子們也喜歡娃娃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are these masks scary or funny?
dialogue.zh: 這些面具是嚇人還是搞笑？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 都有！戴著它們上街遊行跳舞。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They are gone after the festival.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What else is on this shelf?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two jars make a nice gift.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They sew by hand every night.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 這些圖案也代表好運嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 是的，它們代表美好的祝福。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 這裡每樣東西都有一個故事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 這把圓圓的扇子是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good idea, the summer is hot.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much are the mini ones?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three dollars for each little fan.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I buy the big fan?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It fits right in your bag.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, old photos in this corner!
dialogue.zh: 快看，這個角落掛著老照片！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They show the town long ago.
dialogue.zh: 拍的是很久以前的城鎮。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 那時的街道看起來好安靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 同樣的街，不一樣的年代。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are these old prints for sale?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 選得好，裝進相框很好看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 小朋友天天都在找它們。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are they warm enough for winter?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The slippers? Small, medium, and large.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 你看起來像要去看雪的人了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 說不定雪會自己來找你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this shelf all local art?
dialogue.zh: 這一整架都是當地的作品嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 每位創作者都住在附近。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 這讓它們更與眾不同了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 你帶回家的是真實的故事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have a postcard rack?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 挑那張古城堡的風景吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 可以在你們這裡寄明信片嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, drop them in our box.
dialogue.zh: 可以，丟進店裡的信箱就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 一張明信片貼一張郵票嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One for local, two for abroad.
dialogue.zh: 寄本地一張，寄國外兩張。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 你姊姊在收集明信片，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, she has a big box!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 送愛爬山的朋友剛剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A river view for my cousin.
dialogue.zh: 再挑一張河景的送表妹。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我有在收藏冰箱貼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 這個旋轉架上就有幾百個。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 不會，它們連照片都壓得住。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This orange cat is famous here.
dialogue.zh: 這只橘貓在本地很有名。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A shop cat, he greets guests.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 很多客人都把牠帶回家。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 要不要也幫哥哥帶點什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 我們的鑰匙圈掛在那邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hand carved, one of a kind.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 每位師傅都在底部簽名。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 收藏的人會查看每個細節。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the elephant make a sound?
dialogue.zh: 這只大象會發出聲音嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The bells say he is near.
dialogue.zh: 鈴一響就知道他到家附近了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eight dollars with a gift bag.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: For all keychains, small or big.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have a boat keychain?
dialogue.zh: 有小船造型的鑰匙圈嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Blue boat, with a tiny sail.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then take him the little boat.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are these strong enough for keys?
dialogue.zh: 這些夠結實能掛鑰匙嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I get a bigger basket?
dialogue.zh: 能換個大一點的籃子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I buy a magnet set?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What comes in a six set?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 小鎮的聲音很好聽，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The set is on the table.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do the cards match the magnets?
dialogue.zh: 明信片和冰箱貼是同款圖案嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What would you pick for me?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 上面畫著小小街道的那種？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 對，圖案封在透明樹脂下面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 有適合送老師的卡片嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Flower cards sell fast in spring.
dialogue.zh: 花朵卡春天一下子就賣光。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 你的禮物清單越拉越長了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 籃子越大，價位就越親切。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 買得開心的人才會回頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 帶朋友來，他們有小禮物。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我們可以算一下總數嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cards, magnets, the charm, one print.
dialogue.zh: 卡片、冰箱貼、護身符、一張照片。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much with ten percent off?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 四十塊再加一個免費書籤？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 送你兩個，你算是熟客了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: But I am just a tourist.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 在這裡，遊客都會變熟客。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 可以幫我把禮物包起來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 紅色、金色或素色牛皮紙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 先把餃子冰箱貼包起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: For your mom, a big bow?
dialogue.zh: 給媽媽的，要繫大蝴蝶結嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 樸素地包，暖人的話寫裡面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I write a card here?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 你們有厚一點的卡片嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if my spelling is bad?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 手寫的心意會原諒錯字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I use your red pen?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 跟我們店的看板同一色系。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 上面那幾隻鳥是我女兒畫的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She is in back, folding paper.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then it is in good hands.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I add a photo too?
dialogue.zh: 我還能塞張照片進去嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 把它插在緞帶下面就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 我們包得像阿嬤一樣仔細。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 這是我聽過最美的誇獎。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can these two be one gift?
dialogue.zh: 這兩樣可以包成一份嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 它們看起來本來就是朋友。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 這主意真可愛，就這麼辦。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the ribbon free with wrapping?
dialogue.zh: 包裝用的緞帶是免費的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, it is free of charge.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, take your time now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I pay at the counter?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here it is, the blue one.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, I will fill the form.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you write the hotel too?
dialogue.zh: 飯店名稱也幫我寫上嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I get money back now?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where can I mail these cards?
dialogue.zh: 這些明信片要在哪裡寄？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I want to ship this box.
dialogue.zh: 我想把這個盒子寄回家。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 我們現在就能幫你打包。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three days, and it costs more.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sea is fine, I am patient.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我可以在旁邊看你們打包嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 破掉的蜂蜜可賣不出去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 最後再添一張明信片，留給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 當然，今天想挑哪個風景？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The night one is a keeper.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Show me, I still have time.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 新的冰箱貼，小台燈造型。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 台燈造型的冰箱貼？真聰明。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 冰箱燈一亮它就會發光。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then it is meant for me.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我的紙箱都貼好標籤了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 貼好了，這就上路回你家。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 我們最愛又累又開心的臉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We'll save the next crane for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /wil seɪv ðə nɛkst kreɪn fər ju/
dialogue.zh: 下一批紙鶴貨到，先給你留。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 故事會跟著禮物一起旅行。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 再見，回來的時候別著涼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我現在就覺得好運當頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 晚安，回家的路一路平安。
